name: Cod a la Maitre D'hotel
author: Isabella Beeton (1861)

source.name: Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management

ingredients.item: a little chopped shalot and parsley
1/4 teaspoonful of grated nutmeg, or rather less, when the flavour is not liked

steps: Boil the cod, and either leave it whole, or, what is still better, flake it from the bone, and take off the skin.
Put it into a stewpan with the butter, parsley, shalot, pepper, and nutmeg.
Melt the butter gradually, and be very careful that it does not become like oil.
When all is well mixed and thoroughly hot, add the lemon-juice, and serve.

culture.text: From Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management (1861) by Isabella Beeton. It was a Victorian best-seller that shaped how British households cooked and ran their kitchens for generations, and it was one of the first cookbooks to list ingredients before the method.
